comment: This module has no manual. The voices are built on the daisysp analog drum models, and the ranges quoted for the kick, the snare and the compressor were read from the installed build. The knob the panel labels NOISE sets the decay of the snare in the code, while SNAP sets the balance of noise against the body; the maker names them Snare Noise and Snare Snap. The sidechain output is the mix passed through a slew limiter.
